settings.postponeIntro: Pick a new date and first see everything that changes: the tasks that move, the guests who said yes, the money. Nothing is applied until you confirm.
settings.noDate: The occasion has no date yet.
settings.postponeSubmit: See what changes if you postpone
settings.cancelIntro: First see everything affected: tasks, guests, expenses, suppliers. Guests who left an email address are told only after you confirm.
settings.cancelSubmit: See what happens if you cancel
settings.closeoutIntro: After the event: what is left to pay or return, what you learned, and closing the occasion.
settings.freshBody: Postponing, cancelling and closing need a recent confirmation.
settings.alreadyClosed: The occasion is closed and can no longer be postponed or cancelled.

whatif.notifyNobody: No household left an email address
whatif.notifyNote: Each gets one email, after you confirm. The others see the change on their invitation page.
whatif.notifyPageNote: Guests see the change on their invitation page.
whatif.retentionRow: Private requests are deleted after {days} days
whatif.retentionNote: Receipts and financial records are kept for 7 years.
whatif.openItemsRow: Still open in the closeout list: {count}
whatif.openItemsNote: You can still see them, but no longer change them.

impact.tasksCancelNote: They stay in the list, unchanged.
impact.guestsCancelNote: They will see the cancellation on their invitation page.
impact.guestsPostponeNote: They will see the new date on their invitation page. Their answers stay.
impact.expensesPaidCancelNote: They stay on record. Check what can be recovered from suppliers.
impact.expensesUnpaidNote: Still to pay or to sort out.
impact.ledgerNote: The debt stays until you settle it.

guest.postponed: The occasion has been postponed. See the new date below.

cancelled.subject: {occasion} has been cancelled
cancelled.bodyNoDate: We are letting you know that “{occasion}” has been cancelled. We are sorry for the change.

postponed.subject: {occasion} has been postponed
postponed.body: We are letting you know that “{occasion}” has been postponed. The new date is {date}.
postponed.bodyNoDate: We are letting you know that “{occasion}” has been postponed. The new date will be announced.

email.where: The up-to-date details are on your invitation page, at the link you received.
email.why: You get this message once, because you left your email address when you answered the invitation.

closeout.title: Closeout
closeout.description: What is still open after the event, what you learned, and closing the occasion.

hero.label: Left to sort out, today {date}
hero.some: Sort them out, or close the occasion as it is.

closeout.noSections: You have no access to the financial data, so outstanding amounts are not shown here.
closeout.closeIntro: Closing makes the occasion read-only and starts the retention periods: private requests are deleted after {days} days, and receipts are kept for 7 years. You will see a preview first.
closeout.closedBody: Closed on {date}. The data can be read but no longer changed.
closeout.managersOnly: Only the owner or the project manager can close the occasion.

lessons.title: What you learned
lessons.intro: The notes stay in your account and we show them when you plan your next occasion.
lessons.label: Lessons for next time
lessons.hint: For example: “book the band 9 months ahead”, “fewer courses on the menu”.
lessons.saved: The notes were saved to your account.
lessons.pastEmpty: You have no notes from other occasions yet.

errors.closed: The occasion is closed and can no longer be changed.
errors.sameDate: This is the current date. Choose another day.
errors.dateInPast: The new date must be in the future.
errors.dateEarlier: Postponing means a later date. For an earlier date use “Move the date”.
